programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.sub-title: Lighthouse Cocktail Shaker, Cigar Cutters, Jade Disc
programme.desc: Looking to mix things up is Sarah, bearing an impressive silver-plated lighthouse-shaped cocktail shaker. She's brought her own Elvis impersonator to woo the dealers, but she might get even more help from our very own Nigel Havers. Jason continues to bring the bling, with a uranium glass jewellery set that radiates class. He clearly has a great eye, but will the dealers share his taste? Third to face the dealers is Kamran from Bradford. He's got a papal artifact he found in the attic, and backed up by some diligent research, he's looking to move it on. Clayton doesn't know much about his jade disc, but that just means it might be a sleeper hit. So, will he be able to earn a pretty penny on this charity shop find? Smoking may be bad for your health, but selling smoking memorabilia can be good for your bank balance. Danni's stylish cigar cutters certainly fit the bill, but the buyers will have to work hard, as she won't let them go for a snip. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Celebrity Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents this high-stakes quiz as a team of soap stars, featuring EastEnder Danielle Harold, Hollyoaks's Lucy-Jo Hudson, Coronation Street's Simon Gregson and Emmerdale's Chris Bisson, get together to take on the Bridge of Lies for their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and 10 lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge, they just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash for their chosen charities. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pointless

programme.title: Film: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
programme.desc:
Der junge Coriolanus Snow wird mit 23 Mitschülern an der Akademie des Kapitols zu den ersten Mentoren der Hungerspiele ernannt. Um sich die Chance auf ein begehrtes Stipendium zu sichern, muss er den Auftritt seines Tributs – die Wandermusikerin Lucy Gray Baird aus Distrikt 12 – bei den zehnten Hungerspielen zu einem Spektakel machen. 

Die durch den Krieg gegen die Rebellen verarmte Familie Snow droht sonst in die Bedeutungslosigkeit abzurutschen. Coriolanus’ unbändiger Ehrgeiz und die aufkeimenden Gefühle für Lucy Gray treiben ihn an, alles aufs Spiel zu setzen… 

Wie wurde Präsident Snow zu dem Tyrannen, den wir aus der „Die Tribute von Panem“-Reihe (2012–2015) kennen, der darin von Donald Sutherland gespielt wurde? Francis Lawrence, Regisseur der Filme ab „Catching Fire“ (2013), geht dieser Frage im Prequel getreu der Romanvorlage „Das Lied von Vogel und Schlange“ (2020) von Suzanne Collins nach. Die fabelhaft ausgestattete Dystopie erzählt ein neues Kapitel Panems, das sich im Ton und inhaltlich von den Vorgängern erheblich unterscheidet. So bietet das Prequel eine frische Ergänzung zum Franchise, die zur spannenden Charakterstudie um den jungen Snow wird. 

Leider geht bei dessen Entwicklung im Gegensatz zur Vorlage etwas Tiefe verloren. Trotzdem gelingt die Rückkehr nach Panem auch dank der starken Hauptdarsteller Tom Blyth (Snow) und Rachel Zegler (Lucy Gray).

programme.title: Film: Another Simple Favor
programme.desc:
Nach ihrer Entlassung aus dem Gefängnis taucht die hübsche Emily Nelson überraschend wieder im Leben von Stephanie Smothers auf. Die ehemalige Vloggerin und heutige True-Crime-Autorin wird eingeladen, als Trauzeugin bei Emilys Hochzeit mit dem wohlhabenden Italiener Dante Versano auf Capri dabei zu sein. Obwohl sie Bedenken hat, reist Stephanie nach Italien. 

Dort trifft sie auf alte Bekannte und Angehörige der beiden Familien. Die Feierlichkeiten werden jedoch von mehreren mysteriösen Todesfällen überschattet. Während die Polizei ermittelt, gerät Stephanie plötzlich selbst unter Mordverdacht. Auf der Suche nach der Wahrheit stößt sie auf lange verborgene Familiengeheimnisse, falsche Identitäten und ein kompliziertes Netz aus Täuschungen, das weit über das hinausgeht, was sie bisher über Emily zu wissen glaubte… 

Während der Vorgänger noch auf einem erfolgreichen Roman basierte, erzählt die Fortsetzung eine vollständig eigene Geschichte und biegt sich einiges so zurecht, dass man viele altbekannte und neue Gesichter zusammenbringen konnte. Auch an der Humor- und Gewaltschraube wurde ordentlich gedreht. Manche Gags zünden, einige schießen aber auch über das Ziel hinaus. Trotzdem: Wer den ersten Teil mochte, wird sich hier gut zurechtfinden.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A developer in East Sussex wants to add an extra floor onto a three-storey building, but will he be successful? A mum of four is tackling a project in Dorset with the help of relatives. Another family affair in Derbyshire involves sorting out some serious-looking cracks. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing.
programme.desc: Paul and Bob venture to the northernmost reaches of the UK – Shetland – to fish the lochs and the seas of this remote and beautiful place for trout and pollock. Shetland is an archipelago of about 100 islands off the north east coast of Scotland, only around 15 of which are inhabited. It feels like they have entered a very different world – and it's full of surprises for both of them. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI have allowed scientists to not only decode complex animal sound data but also begin communicating with animals. While this may mean the salvation of countless animal species, the advent of inter-species communication could also have far-reaching risks for the ecosystem. In her quest to learn about the current state of animal communication, Professor Hannah Fry travels across the world, meeting Cash the talking dog in California and deciphering elephant rumbles in Nairobi. She looks into the question of whether the emerging ability to communicate with animals is one that should be exploited. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson.
programme.desc: Canada's Foreign Minister tells Nick Robinson why she thinks there has been a "rupture" on the world stage, and where that leaves Canada, the US, Europe and the United Kingdom. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show, where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize. Who will swipe their way to victory? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Beechgrove Repotted
programme.desc: Calum Clunie has been growing for the Fife veg and flower shows since he was 15 years old, and now he has an allotment in Leven that has dedicated to growing the largest leeks and most dazzling dahlias. Throughout a growing season, Calum let us in on his show-growing secrets as he grows giant onions and massive cabbages alongside stunning sweet peas and delightful dahlias. As a fitting end to the growing year, Calum hosts his own homegrown show in his grandparent's back garden. It's a real family affair, and there is a visit from a special surprise judge. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Angels One-Five
programme.desc: Second World War drama relating the Battle of Britain through the eyes of the operations room of a Kent fighter station during the summer of 1940. A young, inexperienced pilot has trouble settling into the routine of squadron life, and his adherence to the rule book puts him out of favour with his comrades. Can he win them round? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team enter Border country as the Roadshow visits Manderston, near Berwick-upon-Tweed. Amongst the items featured are pieces from Queen Victoria's household, a gruesome man trap and Lord Palmer's collection of rare biscuit tins. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from Rochester Cathedral in Kent. Antiques expert Elizabeth Talbot falls for a book of fairy tales illustrated by Arthur Rackham, and Adam Partridge discovers an elegant chiming Swiss pocket watch. Presenter Paul Martin meets one of the last remaining survivors of the Dunkirk evacuation during the Second World War. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Dame Laura Kenny, Minah Shannon, Seann Walsh and Ricky Wilson take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: International Football: Scotland v North Macedonia.
Film: Die Hard with a Vengeance
programme.desc: Ein Bombenleger hält die New Yorker Polizei auf Trab. Besonders auf John McClane (Bruce Willis) hat es der Irre abgesehen. Mit Ratespielchen hetzt Simon Gruber (Jeremy Irons) McClane kreuz und quer durch die Stadt und nutzt die allgemeine Verwirrung, um in aller Seelenruhe die Goldreserven der US-Notenbank auszuräumen. Doch er hat nicht mit der Cleverness von McClane und dessen unfreiwilligem Partner Zeus (Samuel L. Jackson) gerechnet… \n\nNachdem er bei Teil zwei pausiert hatte, übernahm wieder John McTiernan das Ruder und riss es scharf herum: Nach den klaustrophobischen Schlachtfeldern von Teil 1 und 2 wird nun eine ganze Stadt zum „Abenteuerspielplatz“. Auch dass Bruce Willis nicht mehr Einzelkämpfer ist, überraschte die Fans. Genial ist Jeremy Irons, der mit diabolischer Freude den Bösewicht gibt.

programme.title: Film: Blue Story
programme.desc: Obwohl ihre älteren Brüder zu rivalisierenden Londoner Gangs gehören, sind die Schüler Timmy (Stephen Odubola) und Marco (Micheal Ward) eng befreundet. Doch es ist nur eine Frage der Zeit, bis auch sie in den brutalen Bandenkrieg hineingezogen werden.\n„Blue Story“, das Regiedebüt des britischen Rappers ­Andrew Onwubolu, der sich selbst Rapman nennt, basiert auf der dreiteiligen YouTube-Serie „Shiro’s Story“. Rapman, der sporadisch als musikalischer Erzähler auftritt, gewährt den Zuschauern mit seinen Raptexten einen unverfälschten Einblick in die Gedankenwelt der beiden Protagonisten, die sich zu erbitterten Feinden entwickeln. Die atemlose Inszenierung verleiht den Ereignissen ein hohes Maß an Authentizität. Dazu tragen auch die lokalen Dialekte bei (weshalb auch die englische Fassung nur mit Untertiteln gezeigt wird). Mit ihrem Charisma haben die beiden Hauptdarsteller entscheidenden Anteil an der elektrisierenden Wirkung, die der Film entfaltet. Auf imposante Weise wandelt sich Stephen Odubola als Timmy vom sanften Teenager zum skrupellosen Gangster. Es gibt Momente im Film, in denen man ihn kaum wiedererkennt. \nDass es bei Kinovorstellungen in London vereinzelt zu gewaltsamen Auseinandersetzungen kam, zeigt, wie sehr die Ereignisse im Film der Realität entsprechen. Rapman lässt dennoch keinen Zweifel daran, dass sich die Gang­mitglieder in einem sinnlos erscheinenden Teufelskreis befinden, der ständig neue Opfer fordert.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: Desperate to recover their losses, the Phelans strike a deal with Ozzie Thompson. At Jamie and Melissa's engagement party, Michael and Diana attempt to broker peace with the family. Meanwhile, Freddie spirals further out of Michael's control. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Hollywood legend Bill Murray begins a journey around Ireland, combining golf with a search for his Irish roots. But travelling with Bill rarely goes to plan. In Kinsale, chance encounters turn a simple walk into an adventure, while friend and golf writer Tom Coyne tries to keep things on track. Golf brought Bill to Ireland, but the best moments often happen far from the course. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fire and Floods: Our Extreme Weather.
programme.desc: Whether you were wading through floods or struggling through a heatwave, 2026 was the year when you could hardly miss our extreme weather. Temperatures in the summer topped 30C for 33 days in a row. Months earlier, some parts of the UK saw 40 consecutive days of rain. The BBC's climate editor Justin Rowlatt investigates the impact of climate change on our weather. He speaks to scientists who warn that hotter summers and wetter winters are likely to become more typical, and looks at if enough is being done to adapt our towns and cities to the changing climate. Justin asks, as the cost of living continues to bite, are governments under pressure to ditch some green policies, or do they remain committed to tackling climate change? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The Gnome Crystal Mine has ground to a halt, leaving the forest with no crystals, no power supply and melting ice lollies! The heroes are tasked with a quest to find out what has happened and to fix it. It turns out that a slimy beast named Smarg has made the mine her home. But with Hoofius's fear of gunk getting the better of him, evicting the slippery Smarg is not going to be easy. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings: World Tour.
Pokémon Horizons
programme.sub-title: Liko and Hattrem, Bonded by Happiness!

programme.title: Winx Club – The Magic Is Back
Blue Peter: Children in Need SPOTacular.
Around the World in 80 Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits the world's 80 most inspiring gardens, this time in south east Asia. Since the 19th century, western gardeners have loved tropical gardens. Monty visits the archetype – the mysterious Jim Thompson's Garden in Bangkok. He seeks something more authentic in the Royal Palace gardens and the floating gardens of the canals of Bangkok. In Bali, his preconceptions are challenged again. Is the western picture of the exotic garden a construct? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: My Life at Christmas: Anita Rani Meets Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster.
programme.desc: In a rare in-depth interview, Sir Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster welcome Anita Rani into their home to discuss their lives, family, fame and faith, and how Christmases past and present have shaped them. Across an intimate fireside chat, Christmas crafting in a festive greenhouse and a stroll around the stunning grounds of their countryside home, they reflect on Rod's rise to fame, Penny's journey from model to special constable and festive traditions, including exchanging gifts with Elton John. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya presents the very best weekend breakfasts for kicking back, relaxing and really indulging in the pleasure of the day's first meal. And, of course, they are all easy, effortless and baked in the oven. First up are Nadiya's delectable granola cupcakes for a delicious breakfast on the go. A sticky fruit-and-nut granola shell is filled with chocolate and yoghurt before being crowned with edible flowers and fruit. Next, Nadiya offers up a refreshing start to the day with a kiwi, mint and spinach smoothie packed with energy-boosting oats. And, for a little indulgence at the weekend, this vibrant fruity delight is topped with crispy coconut croissant bites, a flurry of crushed frozen raspberries and a drizzle of yoghurt and honey. Nadiya's sweet breakfast wraps have a deliciously gooey baked banana and peanut butter filling, encased in a sugary, spiced tortilla wrap and drizzled with decadent dark chocolate. They are a perfectly indulgent way to relax into the weekend, as a batch can be baked in a matter of minutes. Finally, Nadiya shares one of her best-ever rule-breaking recipes. She takes the traditional English fry-up to a new level by turning it into a pizza topping. Pillowy soft pizza dough with a crisp crust, smothered in a tomato and baked bean base and topped with succulent sausage, moreish mushrooms, tangy cheese, crispy onions and a perfectly runny egg. This might not be one for the purists, but it is the breakfast of champions. Meanwhile, 18-year-old baker Kitty Tait from Oxfordshire shares her ingenious recipe for za'atar honey and feta swirls. At just 14, Kitty started to suffer from debilitating anxiety, but with the help of her dad, discovered that the simple pleasure of baking bread transformed her mental health. Kitty's love of baking blossomed, and she now runs an acclaimed artisan bakery and is definitely a star of the future. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Ice Cold In Alex
programme.desc: During the German offensive in Libya in 1942, Captain Anson, commander of a motor ambulance convoy, finds himself cut off from his unit with only an old ambulance to take him back to Alexandria. His companions are two young nurses and his sergeant, Tom Pugh. As the little party sets off on the long journey, they meet Van der Poel, a South African captain who begs a lift. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Match of the Day Wales: Norway v Wales.
International Football: Northern Ireland v Ukraine.
programme.desc: Stephen Watson presents full match coverage from Windsor Park as Northern Ireland take on Ukraine in the Nations League. With just two matches remaining, Northern Ireland remain firmly in contention for promotion from League B. However, Ukraine could provide a major test as Michael O'Neill's side look to bolster their position ahead of a potentially decisive final fixture. Commentary is by Thomas Kane and Stephen Craigan, with expert analysis from Stuart Dallas, Caragh Hamilton and David Healy. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1975 at the BBC
programme.desc: Take a musical trip back in time with 40 essential hits from the year 1975, plucked from the BBC's archives. The punk explosion was two years away, and disco was only just starting to surface, but these 12 months were still packed with classic songs that remain staples to this day. Key moments include ABBA in Blackpool on Seaside Special, the Bay City Rollers riding the wave of Rollermania, and debut hits from key artists who were pioneers in their individual genres, including Bob Marley, Supertramp and Kraftwerk. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Godland
programme.desc:
Ende des 19. Jahrhunderts bricht der junge dänische Priester Lucas (Elliott Crosset Hove) zu einer beschwerlichen Reise in den entlegenen Osten Islands auf. Seine Mission: eine Kirche errichten, Seelen gewinnen und das unbekannte Land mit seiner Kamera dokumentieren. Doch was als religiöser Auftrag beginnt, wird bald zu einer existenziellen Prüfung.

Die karge, wilde Landschaft lässt ihn staunen und verzweifeln zugleich. Der Regen scheint kein Ende zu nehmen, die Wege sind beschwerlich, die Menschen wortkarg oder feindselig. Lucas, fremd in Sprache und Geist, gerät an die Grenzen seiner körperlichen und seelischen Belastbarkeit.

Das ruhige Drama überzeugt durch eine einzigartige Kameraführung und visuelle Gestaltung.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: The tragic events of the party send shock waves through the Phelans. As dangerous secrets threaten to come to light, Michael is forced to make a difficult confession to Diana. Meanwhile, unseen dangers close in, and it becomes clear no-one is safe. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: My Life at Christmas: Anita Rani Meets Ade Adepitan.
programme.desc: Anita Rani meets Paralympian and broadcaster Ade Adepitan to hear his inspirational life story and how sport, spirituality and the festive season have shaped him, from contracting polio as a toddler in Nigeria, to growing up with a disability in east London in the 1970s, to the rocky road that led to Paralympic glory with the British wheelchair basketball team. Now a respected broadcaster, Ade shines a light on the causes that are close to his heart. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Figures for the first seven months of the year show milk production in Northern Ireland is heading for a record year. But fluctuating prices, rising costs and the ever-present threat of disease have left many dairy businesses under financial pressure. Alongside local farmer Emily McGowan, Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across County Antrim, one of Northern Ireland's most productive dairy regions, are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future. Adam also introduces this year's BBC Food and Farming Awards Countryfile Young Countryside Champion nominees. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie is in Castlemilk housing estate on the southern edge of Glasgow, where he explores a local nature reserve that has transformed from perceived no-go zone to a thriving, green place. Arlene steps back in time in Aberdeenshire as she visits a rare shoemaker's workshop that shut up shop over 80 years ago. She meets the locals carefully conserving the shop's contents. Anne is in the Black Isle, finding out about a charity funded by Children in Need that is providing bereavement support across the Highlands. And Dougie watches on as one couple's herd of Aberdeen Angus cattle leaves the farm for good to go under the hammer at a dispersal sale. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sian Eleri's BBC Children In Need Road Trip
programme.desc: Radio 1 presenter Sian Eleri takes on an almighty challenge when BBC Children in Need's Pudsey Bear sends her on a Wales-wide road trip. Her mission is to find six Children in Need-funded projects across Wales that support the development and well-being of young people. But Pudsey doesn't make it easy. Each step of the way, she must solve one of Pudsey's riddles before she can proceed to her next destination. The bear has also roped in BBC 1's Morning Live presenter Gethin Jones and Radio 2's early breakfast show host Owain Wyn Evans to bamboozle Sian on her journey. The first project is at Tal Y Sarn farm on Anglesey, where BBC Children in Need-funded gymnastics sessions helped 18-year-old Abby overcome anxiety and an eating disorder. Next, Sian visits Theatr Clwyd in Mold. There, she meets Eleanor, who has global developmental delay and autism. Sian hears how the Theatr's Fuse sessions give Eleanor an important creative outlet and safe space to make friends and build her confidence. Sian's third project is ASD Rainbows in Mountain Ash in the Cynon Valley. Here, BBC Children in Need funding pays for staffing for an after-school club which supports neurodivergent children like seven-year-old Olly. And in Cardiff Bay, Sian learns how a grant to the project Silkfutures, to support rap music sessions, has helped develop many young people's self-confidence and given them the space to express themselves freely. Next is Talking Hands, a charity in Swansea that teaches British Sign Language and supports deaf youngsters in Wales like eight-year-old Tom. Sian's final project is Surfability. Based at Caswell Bay beach on the Gower peninsula, it helps children with additional needs and their siblings go surfing together. Here, the Radio 1 presenter has the chance to meet twin brothers Jakey and Ethan and see how Jakey, who has Down's syndrome and is non-verbal, takes to the surfboard like a duck to water. Along the way, Sian's resilience is tested when she takes up pottery, mountain biking, surfing and open-air swimming before being reunited with Pudsey, who surprises her with an end-of-road trip wrap party. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Andi Oliver takes a classic British dessert and transforms it into a savoury number with her three cheese and leek bread and butter pudding. She then grills slices of it with a rarebit sauce on top, serving it with a leek and spinach veloute. Niklas Ekstedt brings the taste of Sweden to the studio with the iconic Jansson's temptation, which he serves alongside a deliciously fatty pork chop. Sabrina Ghayour serves up three tasty treats that are perfect for sharing: lamb barberry and pine nut koftas, pomegranate-glazed aubergines, and muhammara dip. Rick Stein has a dish inspired by his travels, while Paul A Young makes maraschino cherry and almond truffles. And Mel C is in the hot seat to face either her food heaven, roast lamb, or her food hell, okra. Meanwhile, Rick Stein has a peek behind the scenes at how the filming of his shows doesn't always go to plan, and Clive Myrie gets a taste of Caribbean honey. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: With Britain more obsessed with baking than ever, actress and cake expert Jane Asher brings together a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs, for 'The Best Bakes Ever'. Each episode gives baking fans another chance to experience classic dishes from the likes of the James Martin, Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo. There's added insight and appreciation from Jane herself too. Whether its cakes, pies, puddings or main courses – this greatest hits of baking is a must for anyone with a need to knead, and should help inspire even more of us to start getting creative in the kitchen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Jane Eyre
programme.desc:
"Ich wünschte, das Leben einer Frau wäre wie das eines Mannes." Nach einer lieblosen Kindheit findet die junge Waise Jane Eyre im viktorianischen Nordengland des Jahres 1840 eine Stelle als Gouvernante auf dem Gut des reichen Edward Rochester. Trotz seiner schroffen, launischen Art verliebt sie sich in ihn — und Rochester schätzt ihre unangepasste Art. Doch der Hausherr hütet ein dunkles Geheimnis… 

Charlotte Brontë mischte in ihrem Roman 1848 den „Aschenputtel“-Stoff, Spukhorror und frühen Feminismus. Der kalifornische Regisseur Cary Fukunaga („True Detective“) interpretiert Brontës Klassiker als schaurig-dunkles, perfekt durchgestyltes Romantikdrama. Dabei überstrapaziert er die Gruselelemente nicht, stattdessen betont er die Einsamkeit der nach Freiheit strebenden Heldin. 

Darsteller, Musik, die Oscar-nominierten Kostüme sowie die exquisiten, oft nur von Kerzen, Kaminfeuer oder natürlichem Licht erhellten Bilder sind eine Welt für sich. Australierin Mia Wasikowska („Alice im Wunderland“), immer schon ein großer Fan der Vorlage, bat ihren Agenten, nach geplanten Verfilmungen zu suchen. Zwei Monate später erhielt sie das Skript.

programme.title: Film: Spellbound
programme.desc: Gripping Hitchcock thriller in which a psychoanalyst falls in love with her new boss, knowing that he is an amnesiac who may be a killer and an impostor. Characteristically Hitchcockian twists blur reality and imagination as the psychoanalyst struggles to restore his memory. A dream sequence designed by Salvador Dali adds to the suspense. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This episode contains a collection of interesting and previously unseen finds from the show's travels round the country, visiting Margam Country Park in south Wales, Highcliffe Castle in Dorset and Powderham Castle in Devon. The experts include Catherine Southon, Adam Partridge, Philip Serrell, Will Axon, Christina Trevanion and Mark Stacey, with items ranging from a South African Krugerrand coin to a rare walnut-shaped Japanese flintlock. Paul also takes a look at the treasures and lavish interiors at Firle Place in east Sussex. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Golf: Tour Championship Highlights
programme.desc: Final day highlights as the DP World Tour season reaches its climax. The winner of the Race to Dubai is crowned, with Northern Ireland's Rory McIlroy having won the last four editions. McIlroy has won seven Race to Dubai titles, putting him one behind Colin Montgomerie's all-time record. Spain's Engenio Chacarra has enjoyed an incredible breakout season, and the USA's Patrick Reed is firmly in the mix with two wins to his name. Open champion Ryan Fox and PGA champion Aaron Rai also tee it up on the Earth Course at Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai. The top ten DP World Tour members not already exempt will earn a PGA Tour card for the 2027 season. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The third leg of the race sees the teams leave behind the ancient jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail. But with the end of Ramadan fast approaching, the teams must negotiate the crowds heading home for Eid al-Fitr. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: As the days grow longer, the MacDonalds round up their pregnant Highland cattle on the tiny island of Vallay off North Uist for a prenatal check up and vitamin boost. In Newtonmore in the Cairngorms, Jenni's new alpaca arena is finally finished, which means her menagerie of alpacas, donkeys and goats must be moved to their new home. Nikki and Ollie are speculating to accumulate in Moray, splashing out on a new honesty shack. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Paris is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world. Here, the day revolves around patisserie. Morning begins with the buttery flakes of a croissant. At midday, a baguette tucked under the arm signals lunch. And by the afternoon, mouthwatering sweet treats are savoured like miniature works of art. Resistance is futile, and Eva is seduced by the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and dahlia, to name just a few. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon begins his journey in the south of Ireland, paramotoring with an Irish explorer. On the west coast, he does a spot of surfing before climbing Croagh Patrick in honour of Ireland's patron saint. This leg of his journey ends in Malin Head, Ireland's most northerly point. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing.
programme.desc: Bob and Paul are in County Durham, fishing the River Tees for a rare species of wild brown trout. They navigate the area through the lens of a six-year-old Bob as he takes Paul on a trip along the landscapes of his youth. Bob lost his dad when he was very young, but some of the memories he holds dear to him are of the fishing trips they used to go on. Later, Bob invites their old friend Reece Shearsmith to dinner, who has some particularly spooky local tales to tell them about the River Tees. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: As Bill's 75th birthday approaches, brother Joel joins the adventure, bringing some Murray family rivalry to the golf course. Comedian Joanne McNally attempts her first ever round, while a bouncing boat trip to the Cliffs of Moher brings further unexpected encounters. Then friends and familiar faces gather to celebrate a milestone birthday – and a reflective Bill looks ahead to what might come next. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Later with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Jools Holland introduces a special edition of the show starring one of the biggest bands in the world, Fontaines D.C. Marking the release of their album Dopamine Chamber, the Dublin five-piece take to the stage for an intimate performance filmed at Alexandra Palace Theatre in north London. Ahead of a huge global arena and stadium tour, including two nights at the iconic Slane Castle in Ireland, the band play exclusive first performances of tracks alongside unique versions of favourites from their extensive songbook. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc:
Wer Schwäche zeigt, stirbt. Wer keine Entscheidung trifft, stirbt auch. Und wer die falsche Entscheidung trifft, stirbt erst recht. Im Irak kämpfen die US-Soldaten und ihre Verbündeten gegen einen weitgehend unsichtbaren Feind: gegen Heckenschützen, Selbstmordattentäter und Bombenleger, die ihre tödlichen Sprengfallen in Müllhaufen, Leichen und geparkten Autos platzieren. 

„Tödliches Kommando“ schildert den gefährlichen Dienst einer Bombenentschärfungseinheit der US-Armee. Diese Männer sind Teil eines mörderischen Pokerspiels, bei dem es darum geht, wer cleverer ist: der Terrorist oder der Soldat. Die kraftvollen Bilder machen die Gefühlswelt der Protagonisten fast körperlich spürbar – man kann die Angst förmlich riechen. 

Durch den knallharten Dokumentarstil wirkt der Film streckenweise so bedrohlich, dass es einem die Kehle zuschnürt. Kein Wunder, denn Autor Mark Boal war selbst eine Zeit lang mit einem amerikanischen Bombenräumkommando im Irak unterwegs. Seine Erlebnisse bilden die Grundlage für Kathryn Bigelows Kriegsthriller, in dem es keine Guten und keine Bösen gibt – nur die Aussicht auf ein grenzenloses Sterben.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: A knife attack in Inverness leads police to a volatile suspect and a house packed with blades, from Samurai swords to machetes and zombie knives. Released on bail while police await DNA results, he is soon wanted over another violent attack. On the Isle of Skye, rescuers race to find a climber who has been missing for three days in the mountains. And near Fort William, an American tourist has an unusual concern after a crash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Exeter, with politicians, commentators and members of the public. On the panel: from the government, the defence minister Luke Pollard; the Conservatives' shadow AI minister Ben Spencer; Layla Moran from the Liberal Democrats, Matt Goodwin from Reform UK, and comedian and podcaster Deborah Frances-White. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: 1982, East Berlin. MI6 officer Martha Schmitt must maintain her humiliating cover identity as an ordinary East German woman having an affair with British diplomat Graham Anderson. She yearns for serious work, but when the chance to prove herself arrives, she botches it. To redeem herself, she is paired with Kurt Fischer, a CIA officer who ruined her mission. But the Stasi's fearsome Friedrich Baumann has been observing Martha. When he makes a request of her, how can she refuse? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Having survived her close brush with Friedrich, Martha investigates Hermann's murder with Kurt. A sceptical Friedrich orders his men, the inept Otto and Rolf, to also investigate it. After the Stasi seize Hermann's notebook, Martha and Kurt must infiltrate his workplace, a strange sausage factory. They meet Kamilla, his sweet colleague – will she be the key to locating Greta? Meanwhile, now a fugitive, a terrified and confused Greta is running out of options for refuge. Where can she turn? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt: Children in Need
programme.desc: In this special episode, four well-known Radio DJs go head-to-head at one of Britain's biggest antiques fairs to raise money for charity. Hoping to spin loads of profits are BBC Radio 2's OJ Borg and his teammate Melvin Odoom opposite BBC Asian Network's Nikita Kanda and Radio 1's Maia Beth. Let's hope their antiques experts Izzie Balmer and Nick Hall are on the same wavelength as they hunt for bargains among the stalls. A brass pipe sparks a conversation about foreign languages for the reds, but are they speaking the right lingo when it comes to negotiating a good price on some Scandinavian jewellery? Across the fair, Nikita and Maia take a shine to a tatty footstool in the form of a bulldog, but Nick doubts it has any pedigree, and the musical blues compose their own Bargain Hunt song as they try to drum up a profit. At the auction in Chippenham, Izzie confounds her team with a Japanese bonus buy, while Nick hopes his will take off with the bidders. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The oceans have seasons just as the land does. Stretching across the temperate bands located between the freezing poles and the warm tropics lie the seasonal seas. Life is tough in these constantly changing waters, but if animals can persevere and adapt to change, there are myriad opportunities to not only survive but thrive here. Winter in the seasonal seas is a battlefield. Storms whip up immense waves that can travel for thousands of miles, building to 30 metres in height before making landfall. On the Pacific coast of South America, such waves impact the lives of South America sea lions that have lived on this exposed coast for generations. Newborn pups and mothers are restricted to the colony, but the most intrepid males take a risk, leaving the tempestuous coast for unfamiliar waters and unusual prey – black-necked swans. Some choose to escape, whilst others are undeterred by winters icy grip on the seasonal seas. In Patagonia, a female southern right whale arrives in the protected bay where she was likely born, in search of a mate. Testing prospective partners before accepting the best mate, she is rewarded with a gentle belly rub and embrace – a valuable pairing given that these animals were hunted to near extinction in the last century. The whaling ban increased this population from just 300 to 25,000, with a surprising twist – white calves. As daylight lengthens and spring approaches, the greening of the seasonal seas commences. Plankton multiplies, creating huge blooms and feeding many species, including a rather peculiar crustacean, a porcelain crab. In the waters off Chile, over 200 million feast on this bounty, forming the largest-known aggregation of crabs in our oceans. But with limited space and an increased flow of plankton, the crabs do something remarkable – they organise themselves into structured lines, a behaviour that has never been filmed before. As forests flourish on land, they also do so in the water. In spring, kelp, one of the fastest-growing organisms on earth, can lengthen by half a metre a day, forming submarine jungles that are home to a variety of creatures. In Japan, these lush fronds conceal a rarely seen fish, an eelpout, with a length of just ten centimetres. Her bold breeding colours signal she is looking for a mate, but late to the party, she must fight for one in the most peculiar way – by engaging in mouth-to-mouth combat. When spring gives way to summer, temperatures at the coast can rise by 50C in a matter of weeks. Living for just one year, a female octopus oliveri must capitalise on the summer bounty of Japan's rock pools whilst surviving the intense heat. But other octopuses dominate the pools close to shore. In an incredible feat, she pulls herself out of the water and walks on land. But as the heat of the day intensifies, she finds herself far from the water she requires to breathe. Can she make it back before she suffocates? On the Mediterranean coast in summer, the number of people can double. But 50 metres deep in the waters off Corsica, another gathering occurs. Picarel fish create a ten-million-strong supercolony of fish nests across miles of seabed. Here, a father must defend his precious eggs from hermit crabs, sea cucumbers and even other male picarel fish. Against all odds, a few thousand eggs survive an onslaught of cannibals – a job well done by a tenacious dad. At the peak of summer, seagrass meadows can grow ten times thicker than in winter, creating a dense home and feeding ground for many marine creatures. In the lagoon system of the Ria Formosa in Portugal, a long-snouted seahorse tries to find love. But what was once a vast grassland is now an eerily barren world, having been decimated by anchors and fishing boats. The search for a mate seems hopeless, but a lifeline in the form of a "seahorse hotel" created by scientists provides him with a sanctuary and a chance to find a new mate. The oceans are being changed not just by the seasons but by us. Winter waves hit the coast of Chile, washing newborn pups from their colony. Unable to swim, they become stranded. What's more, extreme storms are now four times more common there. But there is hope – committed volunteers aid the return of these helpless pups to the colony to be reunited with their mum. It's autumn in New York City. Thanks to fishing quotas being set in 2013, billions of menhaden fish now swarm along America's busiest coastline, drawing in charismatic marine characters – bottlenose dolphins, sharks and even ocean giants. Once a rare sighting in the waters surrounding the Big Apple, now up to 150 humpback whales feast on the menhaden shoals throughout spring, summer and into autumn. It's a sign that the animals of the seasonal seas show remarkable adaptability and a ray of hope in a rapidly changing ocean. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: See Hear: The Future of Deaf Education.
programme.desc: Marios Costi presents a programme exploring deaf education: where it began, how it has changed and what the future could hold for the next generation. Marios is joined by Martine Monksfield, teacher of the deaf, former president of Batod and long-standing campaigner for improvements in deaf education. Together, they discuss the changes taking place across education, the importance of language and communication, and the need to protect the rights of deaf children, including those with additional needs. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four friends – in this episode, Jacqui, Nigel, Phil and Jane – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman go in search of tips and treats at the York Food Festival, including homemade hummus and the many surprising varieties of the English apple. Father of toddler triplets Onkar Singh Purewal is on the hunt for healthy food the whole family will eat. Ryan Hand gets to grips with Japanese cuisine, and chef Julie Lin reveals some affordable seafood. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo crosses the Culloden Viaduct aboard the Caledonian Sleeper to arrive bright and early in the coastal city of Inverness, from where he heads north on a magnificent scenic adventure to the Orkney archipelago. On boggy moorland overlooking the Moray Firth near Inverness, Michael explores the battlefield at Culloden, where Bonnie Prince Charlie's Jacobite army fought British government troops in 1746. Today, ponies and cattle help to preserve the character of the landscape as it was 275 years ago. Michael learns to execute the infamous Highland Charge and discovers how the Jacobites' catastrophic defeat devastated the Highlands for years to come. Excellent sea and rail links and swathes of lush pine forest in this coastal region have given rise to a strong timber industry. Michael investigates the production of oriented strand board for the construction industry at an Inverness mill, which manufactures 16 million boards annually. The Highland mainline climbs the Slochd summit to deliver Michael to the village of Carrbridge, home of the World Porridge Making Championships. At stake is a golden spurtle – does Michael's whisky-flavoured mushroom porridge risotto stand a chance? At Broomhill, Michael's dreams come true when he is invited to join the crew of the Strathspey Steam Railway on the footplate of their wonderful locomotive as they puff and pant their way past the River Spey and the Cairngorm mountains along the original main line from Inverness to Perth. At Aviemore, Michael heads into Cairngorms National Park to admire its epic scenery. On the banks of Loch Morlich, he learns about writer, poet and naturalist Nan Shepherd, who captured the essence of the Cairngorms in her prose. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: This series charts the contrasting fortunes of British fishing boats over the course of one brutal week. Each skipper must hunt the catch 24/7 if they are to earn a wage for themselves and their crew. It's the most dangerous job in Britain, and failure means risking your life for no reward. In this episode, it's the last trip before Christmas and, with demand surging, fish prices are rising. Off the south coast of Cornwall, Ocean Pride is heading out in pursuit of pollock among the old sunken shipwrecks of the English Channel. 380 miles away on the Yorkshire coast, crabber Tydus is preparing to head out with hopes of a big pay day. The aim is to put six tons in the tank, a catch that this week could fetch well over £30,000. Off the south coast of Devon, Margaret of Ladram, one of Brixham's most successful beam trawlers, is on the hunt for one of the most lucrative species in British waters, Dover sole. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from the ancestral home of the Spencer family, Althorp in Northamptonshire. Nineteen generations have lived here, employing local people to work at the house and vast estate. Antiques experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon find a selection of antiques and collectibles to take to auction. Christina is drawn to a 1950s toy pedal car, and Will finds a Mouseman tray. Paul Martin discovers how the Grand Union Canal was the waterway equivalent of the M1 as he takes to the water on a narrow boat and discovers what life was like for the boat people who ferried cargo from A to B. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Tim Whewell reports from eastern Libya, where a vast reconstruction programme led by the Haftar family is transforming cities and reshaping the country's political future. As new roads, housing projects and landmarks emerge, we examine whether stability and development are outweighing concerns about accountability and democratic change. Plus: we follow Zaher, a young Sudanese boy whose life was changed by war when a drone strike left him severely injured. A year on, we meet him in Cairo as he learns to walk with prosthetic limbs and begins rebuilding a childhood interrupted by conflict. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: The Peelers are back. While patrolling Belfast city centre, Dave and Owen stop a suspected drug dealer. They find a wad of cash and cocaine. The man claims he is a drug user struggling with addiction and, from the back of a cell, tells Stephen about his life. But when speaking to the custody sergeant, he lets slip a crucial detail that confirms Dave's suspicions. Next, reports come in of two men fighting on the street – each claiming to be the victim. After speaking to eyewitnesses and CCTV operators, Anna brings both into custody. On the way, one of the men launches a torrent of abuse at the Peelers. In west Belfast, the vehicle crime team – Dennis and Chris – are on shift and notice a car being driven erratically round a bend. When stopped, the driver, who is known to the team, tries to charm his way out of trouble. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Travel back in time with a compilation of legendary performances of classic acts straight from the archive of one of the most popular music chart shows in history. Top of the Pops was broadcast weekly from 1964 until 2006, welcoming the greatest stars who performed their biggest hits. This special brings you unforgettable musical moments of pop and rock icons like The Rolling Stones, The Beatles, David Bowie, The Who, The Clash, Blur, Oasis and many more. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Girls in Bands at the BBC
programme.desc: This compilation celebrates some guitar-band performances at the BBC that feature some of the best female musicians in rock. Beginning with the oft-forgotten American group Fanny performing You're The One it's a journey along rock's spectrum from 1970s to now. The selection includes the powerful vocals of Elkie Brooks on Vinegar Joe's Proud To Be A Honky Tonk Woman, the mesmerising poetry of Patti Smith's Horses and upbeat energy of The Go-Go's on We Got The Beat.Mighty basslines come courtesy of Tina Weymouth on Psycho Killer and Kim Gordon on Sugar Kane, whilst we trace the line of indie rock from The Au Pairs through Lush, Elastica and Garbage to current band Savages. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fanny: The Right to Rock
programme.desc: The untold story of a California garage band, co-founded in the 1960s by Filipina American and queer teenagers, which morphed into the ferocious rock group Fanny, the first all-female band to release an LP with a major record label (Warner/Reprise, 1970). Despite releasing Top 40 hits and five critically acclaimed albums between 1970 to 1974, counting David Bowie as one of their most vocal fans and touring extensively with bands like Chicago, Steely Dan, Slade and other major groups, Fanny's groundbreaking impact in music has been lost in the mists of time... until bandmates reunite 50 years later with a new rock record deal and a chance to right the wrongs of history. Fanny's brave present-day journey and fascinating backstory is illuminated by rare performance archival footage, photography and celebrity interviews with music legends including Bonnie Raitt, Todd Rundgren, The Go Go's Kathy Valentine, The Runaways' Cherie Currie, The B52's Kate Pierson, Lovin' Spoonful's John Sebastien, Def Leppard's Joe Elliott, David Bowie's guitarist Earl Slick and bassist Gail Ann Dorsey, Charles Neville and Steely Dan's Jeff 'Skunk' Baxter. Fanny blasted glass ceilings of racism and sexism back in the 1960s and 70s, with the lesbian bandmates told to either hide their LBGTQ identity or leave the band, and with their new album, these feisty women, now in their 70s, challenge the stigma of ageism as well. Through the captivating lens of rock 'n' roll, this film raises critical questions about identity, perseverance, love, family and the elusive alchemy of pursuing the American Dream. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Ran
programme.desc: Japan im 16. Jahrhundert: Der greise Herrscherfürst Hidetora Ichimonji will das Reich unter seinen Söhnen Taro, Jiro und Saburo aufteilen. Saburo (Daisuke Ryu), der Jüngste, warnt den Vater vor einer Familienfehde. Erzürnt verstößt Hidetora daraufhin den einzigen Sohn, der ihn wirklich liebt. Aber Saburo behält Recht: Ein blutiges Drama nimmt seinen Lauf…\n\nDer mit 12 Mio. US-Dollar damals teuerste japanische Film ist ein atemberaubendes Schlachtengemälde. Regisseur Akira Kurosawa („Die sieben Samurai“) entfesselt in seiner bildgewaltigen Tragödie den blutigen Irrsinn (Ran bedeutet Chaos). Für die Kostüme gab’s den Oscar.

programme.title: Kurosawa – Arena
programme.desc: An intriguing programme that covers a wide range of topics connected to art, music, design, filmmaking, and theatre. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: People's Palaces: The Golden Age of Civic Architecture
The Medici's: Makers of Modern Art
programme.desc: Without the money of the Medici, we might never have heard of artists such as Donatello, Michelangelo or Botticelli. How did a family of shadowy, corrupt businessmen, driven by greed and ambition, become the financial engine behind the Renaissance? Andrew Graham-Dixon reveals how the Medici transformed Florence through sculpture, painting and architecture and created a world where masterpieces fetch millions today. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Britain''s Most Fragile Treasure
programme.desc: Historian Dr Janina Ramirez unlocks the secrets of a centuries-old masterpiece in glass, the East Window at York Minster. This is the largest medieval stained-glass window in the country and the creative vision of a master craftsman called John Thornton. Within its 311 panels is the entire history of the world, from the first day to the Last Judgment, and the scale of Thornton's achievement is revealed as Dr Ramirez follows the work of a conservation team at York Glaziers Trust. They have dismantled the window as part of a five-year project to repair centuries of damage and restore it to its original glory. It is a unique opportunity for Dr Ramirez to examine Thornton's greatest work at close quarters, to discover details that would normally be impossible to see and to reveal exactly how medieval artists made images of such delicacy and complexity using the simplest of tools. The window is far more than a work of art, it is a window into the medieval world and the medieval mind. (Senderinfo).

actor.role: Self - Centre for Medieval Studies, York

programme.title: Gilbert & Sullivan's the Gondoliers
programme.desc: One of the finest of Gilbert and Sullivan's operas in a sumptuous production by Scottish Opera. Sunny, funny and with more "tra-la-las" per square inch than any other opera in the canon, The Gondoliers is a joy from start to finish. This witty satire is jam-packed with unforgettable star roles, musical highlights and dancing, including numbers such as Take a Pair of Sparkling Eyes, Regular Royal Queen and the Cachucha. The Gondoliers is a charming poke at the appeals and pitfalls of rulership, privilege and cronyism. Two happy-go-lucky Venetian gondoliers, Marco and Giuseppe, discover that one of them is, in fact, heir to the throne of a distant kingdom. True to their (adopted) republican roots, they set off together to rule in idealistic if somewhat chaotic style. Marco and Giuseppe have just chosen their brides, Gianetta and Tessa, when their lives are thrown into turmoil by the arrival of the grand inquisitor, Don Alhambra, who informs them that one of them has acquired the throne of the distant Kingdom of Barataria. The Duke of Plaza-Toro brings his daughter to meet Don Alhambra because she has been betrothed to the new monarch – whichever he is. No-one can identify which of the gondoliers is to be the king, so they both agree to go and rule jointly and according to their strict republican instincts. It's a fine but exhausting ideal, as they find that "equality" means they end up doing all the work themselves. The Duke of Plaza-Toro, bringing his daughter, arrives in the chaotic kingdom, and after vain attempts to teach the monarchs decorum and judgement, the confusion and incompetence is resolved, and the rightful monarch is in place. In a co-production by D'Oyly Carte Opera and State Opera South Australia, Stuart Maunder directs the production with fun, verve and taste, with Scottish Opera's music director, Derek Clark, conducting one of Arthur Sullivan's most attractive and affecting scores. The designs are by Dick Bird, drawing on views of Venice by Canaletto and creating colourful costumes full of style and wit. Isabel Baquero has devised an energetic and boisterous choreography that matches the joy of the production. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alexandre Kominek : Bâtard sensible
programme.desc: C'est un Polonais Tunisien né en Suisse… Ça pourrait être le début d'une blague donc il a décidé d'en faire un spectacle. Alexandre Kominek confirme une trajectoire à part, celle d'un humoriste qui avance sans chercher à arrondir les angles. Son humour frontal bouscule et met à nu les contradictions contemporaines comme le désir, la masculinité ou les rapports sociaux. "Alexandre Kominek est une véritable machine. Pendant 1 heure et 46 minutes, il nous attrape et nous enlace dans une danse endiablée, à grands coups d'histoires aussi folles qu'authentiques. Les délires de votre ami le plus fou ne valent rien à côté de ceux d'Alexandre. Sincère, animal, espiègle, charmeur, fragile, romantique, excessif… L'humoriste suisse est un peu tout ça à la fois. Et plus encore ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Clique
programme.desc: Nouvel horaire, nouvelle formule pour CLIQUE, présenté par Mouloud Achour. A 19h45 Pauline Clavière ouvre le bal avec "Le JT de Clique" , le journal avec tout ce qu'il fallait cliquer dans la journée. Mouloud Achour revient à son exercice signature, le "Clique X" face à face iconique, entretien au long cours avec la personnalité du jour. Un invité sociétal viendra ensuite nous éclairer sur le monde actuel, toujours en clair et en direct ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: En aparté
programme.desc: Des stars d'Hollywood à la scène musicale, du sport à l'humour, en passant par la mode, EN APARTÉ accueille ceux qui font l'actualité. Seul dans l'intimité d'un appartement, sans public et guidé par la voix de Nathalie Lévy, chaque invité se laisse porter par un échange, des images, des objets et les souvenirs qui jalonnent une rencontre unique en son genre. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: La bonne étoile
programme.desc: France 1940. Parce qu'il n'a pas réintégré son unité, Jean Chevalin se retrouve considéré comme déserteur. Pour survivre, il a une idée de génie : se faire passer pour un juif ! Il entraîne toute sa famille dans ce mensonge, et son plan finit par les plonger au cœur de la Résistance. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Têtàtête(s)
programme.desc: Chaque semaine, un grand entretien par Laurie Cholewa avec les talents du cinéma. Un moment convivial et chaleureux qui raconte les coulisses des films les plus attendus en salles, et des films évènements diffusés sur CANAL+. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Chasse gardée 2
programme.desc: Deux ans se sont écoulés depuis l'installation d'Adélaïde, de Simon et de leurs deux enfants à Saint Hubert. Alors qu'ils espèrent que l'arrivée de leurs nouveaux voisins apporte un peu de piment dans leur vie, ils doivent dorénavant partager leur quotidien avec des passionnés de chasse à courre. Eux qui croyaient en avoir fini avec la chasse à Saint Hubert, Adélaïde et Simon ne sont pas au bout de leurs peines… (Senderinfo).

programme.title: La boîte à questions
programme.desc: Sacrifiant au rituel d'une émission au format maintenant bien connu, une célébrité répond aux questions qui lui sont posées en off. C'est une interview aussi décalée que décontractée qui en découle. Les invités se révèlent souvent sous un autre angle, avec spontanéité. (Senderinfo).

Simon, Alex et les autres membres de l'équipage mettent cette fois-ci leur expérience de retraitement du plastique avec les enfants des bidonvilles de l'Inde, collectent de précieuses données scientifiques à travers l'océan Indien et transforment leur bateau pour venir en aide aux réfugiés du Mozambique. programme.title: Super Mario Galaxy le film
programme.desc:
Während Bowser nach seinem fiesen Feldzug im vorherigen Film geschrumpft in einem Minipalast festgehalten wird, schmiedet sein Sohn Bowser jr. Pläne, ihn zu befreien. Zu diesem Zweck hat er die mächtige Prinzessin Rosalina entführt, die mit ihren zahlreichen sternförmigen Kindern namens Luma auf einem eigenen Planeten lebt. 

Einer der Lumas kann entkommen und bittet Prinzessin Peach um Hilfe, seine Mama zu befreien. Sie macht sich sofort gemeinsam mit Toad auf den Weg und überträgt die Verantwortung für das Pilzkönigkreich an Mario. Doch nachdem es Bowser jr. gelungen ist, seinen Vater zu befreien, eilen Mario, Luigi und ihr neuer Kumpel Yoshi ihren Freunden hinterher… 

Marios zweites Abenteuer in Zusammenarbeit von Illumination und Nintendo ist extrem bunt, wild, actionreich und storytechnisch verworren – keine Zeit zum Luftholen! Da hilft nur zurücklehnen und sich von dem Farbenmeer berieseln lassen, in dem immer wieder überraschende und gut durchdachte Easter Eggs für Genießer der Videospiele auftauchen. Und endlich ist auch Fanliebling Yoshi dabei!

programme.desc: Laure s'éveille dans une chambre inconnue. Près d'elle, un homme qu'elle ne reconnaît pas, mais qui affirme être son fiancé. A t'elle été frappée d'amnésie comme le prétend ce dernier ? Mais alors, pourquoi ces bribes de souvenirs confus de scènes d'orgies sexuelles auxquelles elle aurait participé et dont elle croit encore entendre les hurlements du plaisir ?... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc:
In Woodsboro ermordet ein neuer Ghostface ein junges Paar im früheren Haus von Stu Macher, einem der ersten Ghostface-Killer. Während der Täter weiterhin unentdeckt bleibt, führt Sidney Prescott mit ihrem Mann Mark und ihren drei Töchtern in Indiana ein zurückgezogenes Leben. Besonders mit der siebzehnjährigen Tatum gerät sie allerdings immer wieder aneinander, weil Sidney ihre traumatische Vergangenheit verdrängen möchte und Tatums Freund misstraut. 

Dann meldet sich Ghostface, diesmal sogar mit Stus Gesicht, bei ihr und bedroht Tatum. Nach tödlichen Angriffen in einem Schultheater und im Haus der Familie muss sich Sidney eingestehen: Es hört erst auf, wenn sie es selbst beendet... 

Nach einer holprigen Entstehungsgeschichte bekamen Fans der kultigen Slasher-Reihe Anfang 2026 doch noch ihre Fortsetzung zum erfolgreichen sechsten Teil, der ohne die Figur Sidney Prescott auskommen musste. Nun ist der Fan-Liebling wieder Dreh- und Angelpunkt der Geschichte. Es geht zurück zu den Anfängen, während man auch aktuelle Themen wie KI und Deepfakes in die Geschichte einarbeitet. 

Zwar wirkt das ein wenig aufgesetzt, die Action entschädigt jedoch: Ghostface schlitzt sich gnadenlos durch den Cast, und Sidneys harte Gegenwehr beeindruckt. Ergebnis: Inzwischen ist Teil 7 der erfolgreichste der Reihe.

programme.title: Conjuring : l'heure du jugement
programme.desc: Au milieu des années 1980, après un nombre incalculable d'interventions éprouvantes, les célèbres Ed et Loraine Warren, enquêteurs sur les phénomènes paranormaux, ont décidé de cesser leurs activités. Mais les Smurl et leurs quatre enfants, qui vivent un enfer depuis des mois dans leur maison qu'ils disent hantée, ont besoin d'eux. Sur place, les Warren vont être confrontés à leur pire cauchemar. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Amsterdad
programme.desc: Lors d'un week-end raté à Amsterdam, William, seul dans la vie, se fissure sous les yeux de son fils Walter. L'amour, avec l'aide d'une guide touristique, se fraiera t'il un chemin entre les deux hommes ? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Voyage en Autistan
programme.desc: Docteur ès philosophie et écrivain voyageur, Josef Schovanec a été diagnostiqué autiste à l'âge de 22 ans. Il affirme que les voyages lui ont sauvé la vie en lui offrant une forme de thérapie inédite et parfaitement bénéfique. Après avoir découvert l'Ethiopie, la Turquie ou encore le Tadjikistan, il embarque ici pour l'Islande, un pays grandiose dont il décrit les bizarreries et particularités. Ce voyage lui offre en outre l'occasion de faire des rencontres pleines de sens avec des hommes et des femmes qui lui font mieux appréhender leur culture et leurs traditions. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Les génies de la nature
programme.desc: Dans un territoire grand comme la Bretagne, à la frontière des Balkans, la Slovénie concentre une densité du vivant qui défie l'entendement. Ours, loups, lynx, rapaces et pollinisateurs en tout genre peuplent les vallées boisées et les prairies alpines qui couvrent près de 60 % du territoire. Plus singulier encore, un réseau souterrain de galeries s'étend sur des centaines de kilomètres sous les plateaux calcaires, abritant une faune cavernicole parmi les plus riches et les plus endémiques du monde. Accompagnée de biologistes, de naturalistes et de chercheurs qui consacrent leur vie à ces espèces, Marat part à la découverte d'animaux et d'organismes qui incarnent, chacun à leur façon, le génie évolutif du vivant. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Police Flash 80
programme.desc: Paris, années 1980. Quand son coéquipier Johnny Lansky est retrouvé assassiné, l'inspecteur Yvon Kastendeuch prend la tête d'une brigade spéciale antidrogue : la Police Flash 80. Mais ce flic aux méthodes dépassées va devoir diriger trois jeunes flics, Guilaine, analyste rigoureuse, Roberto, maître de l'infiltration, et Marfoud, expert en écoutes. Malgré ce choc des générations, ils vont tenter de démanteler un trafic d'héroïne qui ravage les cités. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: La vengeance au triple galop
programme.desc: Stéphanie Harper, riche héritière assez disgracieuse, épouse Craig Danners, sans se douter qu'il n'en veut qu'à son argent. Non content d'avoir une liaison torride avec Crystal Clear, la meilleure amie de Stéphanie, il profite d'une sortie à cheval pour provoquer un accident et la laisser pour morte au fond d'un ravin... Mais Stéphanie, miraculeusement sauvée, va décider de se venger. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ticaret
programme.desc: Paris, années 1980. Tout premier concept-store en Europe dédié au hip-hop, la boutique Ticaret est à la fois le laboratoire d'un style nouveau, un lieu de rencontres et une fabrique de mythes. Le duo improbable à sa tête, Daniel Fourneuf, un électricien passionné de danse et de musique, et Françoise Hautot, mannequin cabine et créatrice de mode, importe des vêtements, accessoires et albums hip-hop des États-Unis. Ticaret compte aussi un studio d'enregistrement de fortune installé au sous-sol et dans l'arrière-boutique des graffeurs célèbres sérigraphient des T-shirts au style unique dans l'héxagone. À la recherche de nouveautés, d'authentique et d'un morceau de rêve américain, s'y croisent JoeyStarr, Oxmo Puccino, Cut Killer, DJ Mehdi, NTM, Dee Nasty, Mathieu Kassovitz, Doc Gynéco, Booba… (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Saturday Night Live
programme.desc: L'incontournable rendez-vous du rire made in USA est de retour pour une nouvelle saison plus drôle et impertinente que jamais. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Gangs of Copenhagen
programme.desc: Cairo, un ex-membre de gang, travaille désormais comme conseiller en réinsertion. Lorsque son neveu, Hamsa, disparaît, il est contraint de se replonger dans son ancien milieu . (Senderinfo).

programme.title: L'hebd'Hollywood
programme.desc: Entre événements, indiscrétions et exclusivités, le journaliste Didier Allouch propose chaque semaine, depuis Los Angeles, un décryptage très personnel de l'actualité du cinéma américain. News sur les tournages, tendances, films en salles, stars : la cité des Anges livre tous ses secrets. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Rose
programme.desc: Lors d'une bataille spatiale, la capsule de sauvetage d'un robot humanoïde tombe sur une planète qui ressemble à la Terre. Au milieu de la forêt, il découvre une superbe rose. Mais l'ennemi s'écrase lui aussi sur la Terre... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Une furieuse envie de vivre
programme.desc: Gilles est un type qui dévore la vie avec une énergie loufoque et qui, à 32 ans, apprend qu'il a un cancer incurable du pancréas. Il ne peut pas empêcher la mort. Mais il refuse de la laisser lui voler sa vie avant l'heure. Il choisit de SUR-vivre : écrire ses grands rêves et les accomplir, quoi qu'il en coûte. De cette décision, il fait un projet de vie : le "Profitivisme" , le doux mélange entre \" profiter \" et \" rester positif \". Il se lance alors des défis pour continuer à vivre pleinement et inspirer les autres à ne pas attendre pour vivre leurs rêves... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Clique
programme.desc: Nouvel horaire, nouvelle formule pour CLIQUE, présenté par Mouloud Achour. A 19h45 Pauline Clavière ouvre le bal avec "Le JT de Clique" , le journal avec tout ce qu'il fallait cliquer dans la journée. Mouloud Achour revient à son exercice signature, le "Clique X" face à face iconique, entretien au long cours avec la personnalité du jour. Un invité sociétal viendra ensuite nous éclairer sur le monde actuel, toujours en clair et en direct ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: En aparté
programme.desc: Des stars d'Hollywood à la scène musicale, du sport à l'humour, en passant par la mode, EN APARTÉ accueille ceux qui font l'actualité. Seul dans l'intimité d'un appartement, sans public et guidé par la voix de Nathalie Lévy, chaque invité se laisse porter par un échange, des images, des objets et les souvenirs qui jalonnent une rencontre unique en son genre. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Icefall
programme.desc: Sur un lac gelé du nord des Etats-Unis, Ani, jeune garde forestière, se trouve embarquée dans une sombre affaire. Elle vient d'interpeler Harlan, un braconnier en possession d'une mallette pleine de billets venant d'un petit avion accidenté. Traquée par les criminels venus récupérer leur argent, Ani est bientôt contrainte de fuir avec Harlan. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Cash Out 3 : The Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: L'incorrigible Shawn réussit, non sans mal, à sortir son frère Mason Goddard de sa retraite pour l'embarquer dans un ultime casse. Mais Mason et son équipe d'experts en cambriolage vont, sans le savoir, s'attaquer au redoutable Abel Salazar qui vient de s'évader de prison. Ce casse de haut vol, apparemment à leur portée, a en réalité été imaginé par Salazar lui-même, et ne vise qu'à les piéger. Mais Mason n'est pas homme à se laisser faire si facilement. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Super plan
programme.desc: L'émission consacrée à toute l'actualité du 7e art revient pour une deuxième saison ! Avec ses acolytes Mina Soundiram et Renan Cros, Antoine de Caunes recevra chaque semaine celles et ceux qui créent le Cinéma de demain, pour des interviews inédites. L'occasion de mettre en lumière le 7e art avec passion, humour et expertise, en proposant des reportages exclusifs, à travers les coulisses des derniers films à l'affiche, les meilleurs moments de festivals prestigieux, les avant-premières les plus attendues… Une émission au coeur du Cinéma ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Le crime du 3e étage
programme.desc: Professeur de cinéma spécialiste d'Alfred Hitchcock, Colette partage sa vie avec son mari François, romancier. Depuis la baie vitrée de leur loft parisien, le couple a une vue plongeante sur l'appartement de Yann et de Nathalie, leurs voisins qui viennent tout juste de s'installer troisième. Un soir, Colette croit surprendre Yann en train d'agresser sa femme. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Têtàtête(s)
programme.desc: Chaque semaine, une interview par Laurie Cholewa des talents ou cinéastes des films à l'affiche, un moment convivial et chaleureux qui raconte les coulisses des films les plus attendus en salles et des films diffusés sur Canal+. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Maigret et le mort amoureux
programme.desc: Le commissaire Maigret, fin limier de la PJ, est appelé sur une nouvelle enquête, une affaire particulièrement sensible puisqu'un ancien ambassadeur du Quai d'Orsay vient d'être assassiné. Plus Maigret avance dans ses investigations, plus il fait d'étonnantes découvertes, relatives notamment à une liaison qu'avait le défunt avec une princesse récemment veuve. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: L'affaire Bojarski
programme.desc: Lyon, 1943. Émigré polonais, Jan Bojarski, ingénieur, vit de petits trafics et enchaîne les boulots sous-payés. Dans l'impossibilité de faire valoir ses diplômes ni de déposer les brevets de ses inventions, Bojarski accepte de s'associer à un bandit pour fabriquer de faux billets. Un trafic dans lequel il excelle. Le commissaire principal Mattei, meilleur policier de France, se lance à la poursuite du faussaire qui sera surnommé le "Cézanne de la fausse monnaie" . (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Spinners
programme.desc: Alors qu'Ethan et Amahle se rapprochent, une révélation bouleverse la vie d'Amber qui est partie au Cap. Ethan accepte de participer au braquage de Masithole pour sauver ceux qu'il aime. Rongé par la jalousie et la frustration, Sayi devient de plus en plus dangereux. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Antoine de Caunes : la vie "rêvée" d'un enfant du rock
programme.desc: Antoine de Caunes a traversé plus de quatre décennies du PAF… Un peu comme Tintin l'aurait fait au pays des pixels… Et de fait, tout le monde connaît Antoine de Caunes. "Il est le seul survivant de la chaine cryptée. Et c'est un paradoxe. Car il n'a rien fait pour recevoir un tel César d'honneur. C'est presque tout le contraire même. Au-delà de sa personnalité, la réponse est en partie dans le fait qu'il nous a été indispensable pour franchir ces décennies folles de bouleversement social, politique et culturel qui viennent de s'écouler. Il n'avait pourtant pas de plan de carrière. Il est allé là où le vent, ses goûts, et la chance l'ont mené, à droite, à gauche, un peu partout, mais rarement au même endroit. Il a pratiqué un, deux, trois, quatre métiers dans le cœur du PAF hexagonal jusqu'à créer une sorte de PROFESSION(S), la sienne : Antoine de Caunes. Antoine est un lanceur d'alertes culturelles avec un recul, une ironie, une impertinence qui a résonné dans les baffles des années 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010." Autour d'Antoine, des figures qui l'ont accompagné, croisé, témoignent et nous confient les détails de l'aventure. Parmi celles-ci, Paul Smith, Asia Argento, Doria Tillier, Léa Drucker, José Garcia, Roschdy Zem, Karine Viard, Pierre Lescure, Emma de Caunes, Jamie Hewlet et Damon Albarn, Jean-Paul Gaultier, Alexandre Astier, Philippe Djian, Stephan Eicher, Elsa Zylberstein, Monsieur Poulpe, ET… Bruce Springsteen ! (Senderinfo).
